content.short: OtoCo is a community-governed, open-source Web3 platform that lets users form and control legal entities onchain.
content.description: OtoCo is a community-governed, open-source Web3 platform that lets users form and manage legal entities directly from their wallets. It ports legal entities across multiple jurisdictions onto the blockchain, enabling instant incorporation, automated funding, and flexible, liquid governance. By turning companies into code, OtoCo builds blockchain-native organizations that empower anyone—anywhere—to pursue entrepreneurship with fewer barriers and greater autonomy.

resources.title: Pass-Through Taxation for Foreign-Owned US LLCs, in Plain English
resources.tldr: Separates what a non-US owner genuinely owes from what they merely have to file, which are very different lists and the source of most of the confusion.

resources.title: Best State to Form a US LLC as a Foreigner
resources.tldr: Wyoming against Delaware, and the cases where neither is the right answer. Structured as a decision guide rather than a ranking, which is what the question actually needs.

resources.title: LLC for a Token Launch: The Legal Setup Founders Miss
resources.tldr: Who owns the treasury, who owns the IP, and what the entity is actually for. These get decided by accident before a launch far more often than they get decided deliberately.
